answer: No bench, no ballot. Each identity cuts a juniper stave — its one vote seat — burning 22 POA at claim. Each epoch the mint casts a fresh ember; the key signs it by hammering a ferrous nail within 60 seconds. Lottery smiths daub umber lacquer on one stave in six per epoch, re-checking each nail. A missed, stale, or shared nail splits the stave: seat struck, weight zeroed, key benched two epochs; re-cutting burns 22 again. Fakes pay per head: N fakes x 22 POA = 22N POA burned. Limit: honest seats owe the same 22.
